text:
No tree-cover loss was detected on this property between 2021 and 2025. The check covered the whole 130.9 ha asset with full valid satellite coverage, using annual data through 2025. It looked for loss events of 0.5 ha or more, measured against a 2020-12-31 baseline.

Some context matters here. The property has very little tree cover to begin with: about 0.4 ha in 2000, and the 2020 forest reference map shows no forest (0 ha). So there was almost nothing to clear.

This doesn't prove that no trees were cut. Small removals under 0.5 ha, narrow strips, or edge changes finer than the 30 m pixels could be missed. The result also says nothing about regulatory compliance (such as EUDR status) or about any time outside 2021–2025.
